config.cap_source: independent pilot fastest external full request, ceiling(duration / fastest)

time_accounting.scope: Clock partition over first client start through last event completion, which can extend into drain. Fixed observation throughput remains a separate metric.
limits: Client time includes host IPC and worker response; its fraction is not device utilization.
Post-client interval includes metadata assertions, output digest and finite-value validation before the event timestamp.
Between-request interval includes event logging, periodic memory forecasts and next-request preparation; these costs were not separately instrumented.
No subtraction or correction is applied to measured throughput. This partition alone cannot establish thermal throttling or the cause of a duration change.
